name: Life Energy Blast
description: Fire an energy thorn and regain one Life Orb after a critical hit.

name: Soul Resurgence
description: Release energy around her while moving, providing Healing Over Time and {{ATC|G|Movement Boosts}} for surrounding allies. Excess healing converts to Bonus Health.

stats.CASTING: Persistent spell field that surrounds the caster

name: Healing Flower
description: Consume Life Orbs to grant allies Healing Over Time.

stats.PERCENTAGE HEALING: Heal allies equal to 2.5% of the target's Max Health/s

name: Spore Slumber
description: Throw a spore to Sedate the nearest enemy.

stats.CASTING: Single-cast projectile with delayed impact that also generates a spell field

name: Allied Inspiration
description: Consume Life Orbs to grant allies a Damage Boost.

name: Natural Anger
description: Consume Life Orbs to grant herself a Damage Boost.

name: Nature's Favor
description: Receive a Movement Boost when not injured and Healing Over Time when consuming Life Orbs.

name: Heavenly Guardian
description: Mantis enhances Groot's wooden walls and Loki's Rune Stones with life energy. Groot can additionally unleash a Wild Wall, which, when in Flora Colossus state, restores health to random nearby allies and grants them Damage Reduction. Loki's Rune Stones grant allies within Regeneration Domain a Damage Boost.
